title: automated-tenant-residency-evidence-generator-for-dedicated
creator: Ana Patel
description: Build an automated evidence and attestation generator for Dedicated tenants that proves data residency, retention settings enforcement, and tenant isolation properties. The output should be a verifiable bundle (human- and machine-readable) containing logs, config snapshots, cryptographic signatures, and a concise PDF attestation for customers and auditors. The generator must integrate with existing Dedicated control plane APIs, storage backends (S3-compatible), and the audit log pipeline. It should support scheduled and on-demand runs, per-tenant customization, and retention-aware redaction so proofs only include permitted artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Produces a ZIP evidence bundle and a one-page PDF attestation for a tenant that includes: residency map, retention policy snapshot, active tenant firewall rules, audit log excerpts, and storage encryption metadata
Each bundle is cryptographically signed by a platform key and contains a verifiable signature file with key id and timestamp
Bundles can be generated on-demand via API and scheduled (daily/weekly) with configurable retention of evidence artifacts
Redaction rules remove PII and respect tenant retention settings when assembling bundles
Generated attestations are stored in tenant's audit export location and accessible via a signed URL with configurable TTL
Automated tests cover proof generation, signature verification, and redaction logic
implementation_notes: New service component: residency-attestation-generator (Go) to run as CRON job and on-demand via control-plane RPC
Use existing audit-log-query service to pull log slices; add query parameters for timebox and redaction mode
Signing: use HSM/KMS integration already used by Dedicated key management; sign bundle manifest with ECDSA and include key version
Store bundles to tenant S3 path: s3://<tenant>/evidence/residency/YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS.zip
Expose API endpoint: POST /tenants/{id}/evidence/generate with body {window, redaction_level, include_config:true/false}
Add a lightweight templating engine (Mustache) for PDF attestation layout consumed by render-worker
Ensure idempotency by tracking bundle generation requests in DB with digest of inputs
steps: Design data model for evidence manifests and signing metadata
Prototype minimal bundle generator in sandbox with static files
Integrate audit-log queries and config snapshot collectors
Wire up KMS signing and store signature metadata in manifest
Implement redaction pipeline and unit tests for edge cases
Add API endpoint and admin UI hook in Console for on-demand generation
Create scheduler for periodic runs and retention cleanup job
Run internal compliance review and iterate on attestation wording
Document API and provide example signed URL retrieval flow

risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Bundles may unintentionally contain PII. Mitigation: strict redaction rules, unit tests, and Compliance sign-off before GA
Risk: Signing key exposure. Mitigation: use KMS/HSM with limited personnel access and audit logging
Risk: Large evidence bundles blow up storage costs. Mitigation: configurable retention and compression plus dedupe of repeated artifacts
Risk: Customers confuse attestation with SLA. Mitigation: clear wording in PDF and Confluence explaining scope and limitations
